name: Ember Console
concept: A single hot orange carries every chart series, CTA and alert across an otherwise white hairline shell.

type.families: Neo-grotesque single family (Inter / Söhne). Numerals tabular in every metric.
type.hierarchy: Modal title 20/28 semibold · metric 28/34 semibold tabular · card title 14/20 semibold · body 13/18 regular · label 11/14 medium in `--muted`.
type.usage: Sentence case. Metrics get the largest optical weight on the screen. Deltas are 12px medium with a directional arrow glyph, coloured `--positive` / `--negative` — these are the only colours allowed to compete with the orange.

tokens.texture: Flat white on flat white, separated by hairlines. Charts are drawn in `--accent` alone: one solid line for the current series, the same hue at 35% opacity for the comparison series. The one licensed exception is a lilac-to-pink gradient strip used exclusively to mark AI-generated content — nothing else in the system may use a gradient. Modals cast `0 20px 48px -12px rgb(21 23 31 / .24)` over a dimmed (never blurred) parent.
tokens.layout: Detail sheets over context. A modal or side sheet at 720-880px floats over the visibly dimmed parent screen, which stays legible so the user keeps their place. 4px scale, 20px sheet padding, 16px card padding, 10px radius. Two-column metric grids inside the sheet; charts get a full-width row of their own.

best_for: any product where one metric family dominates
avoid_for: multi-brand or white-label products needing colour flexibility
calm or clinical medical contexts where orange reads as alarm

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as flat vector UI illustration, analytics subject matter.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- white ground #FCFCFC with white cards separated by 1px #E6E8EB rules
- exactly one saturated hue — burnt orange #D64B00 — carrying every data series and call to action
- all other elements in near-black #15171F and greys
- flat lighting, no gradients except one optional lilac-pink band
- charts rendered as clean 2px strokes, no fills or textures

NEGATIVE SPACE: Leave the top 25% as clean white for a headline; keep charts in the lower two-thirds.

DO NOT INCLUDE: multiple competing accent colours, 3D charts, neon, glassmorphism, photographic elements, dark backgrounds.
image_recipe.provider: configurable — set to your image provider
image_recipe.model: configurable — set to your image model
image_recipe.resolution: 1536x1024 (3:2 landscape); use 1024x1536 for portrait, 1024x1024 for square
